sentences.en: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.
sentences.zh: 不戴头盔骑摩托车是危险的。

sentences.en: It can be dangerous for young people to ride motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 年轻人骑摩托车可能很危险。

sentences.en: The little girl is not capable of riding a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 小女孩还不会骑自行车。
